Golden Milk Paste (Turmeric Base)

Product golden-milk turmeric daily-support anti-inflammatory

Evidence: opinion

Summary

Concentrated turmeric paste with ginger, black pepper, and coconut oil. Mix with warm plant milk for a daily anti-inflammatory drink.

Supplier: Mountain Herb Farm

Manufacturer: Mountain Herb Farm

Ingredients

  • Organic Turmeric Root Powder
  • Organic Coconut Oil
  • Organic Ginger Root Powder
  • Black Pepper Extract (for bioavailability)
  • Raw Honey or Organic Maple Syrup (sweetener)

Dosage Form: powder

Serving Size: 1 teaspoon paste mixed in 1 cup liquid

Servings Per Container: 30

Usage Instructions

Mix 1 teaspoon of paste with 1 cup of warm plant-based milk. Optionally add cinnamon. Drink 1-2 times daily.

Storage Instructions

Refrigerate after opening; lasts up to 4 weeks. Can also be frozen in ice cube trays for longer storage.

Price Range: $22-30 for 16 oz jar

Certifications

  • USDA Organic
  • Non-GMO
  • Vegan (without honey)
